document.name: Croptop Publishing Network
document.description:
Croptop is a post-platform posting platform for truly independent artists, devs, archivists, shitposters, advertisers, businesses, bloggers, and brands.


CPN collects a 2.5% fee of post sales.


Initial token auto-issuance has been used to make V5 CPN token holders whole.


Juicebox Protocol V6 was deployed in April 2026 in response to discovering a bug with the multi-hook component of V5 revnets, and after the advent of efficient AI agents revealed security improvements that could be made to harden the permanent protocol code.


The V5 and V6 CPN revnets have identical specifications apart from the initial auto-issuance of V6.
document.projectTagline: Post-platform posting platform for independent publishers. Collects revenues from post sales.
